issuing_body: Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT), European Commission
implementation_notes: This is a commissioned study providing market analysis and policy recommendations, not a regulatory instrument. It covers the EU digital health market projected to grow from EUR 11 billion (2023) to EUR 61.2 billion (2035). Policy recommendations include boosting frontier technology innovation, SME support, interoperability, and workforce readiness. No binding obligations or enforcement mechanisms are established.
